title: Especialista De Fluidos
description:
Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Elaboração de projetos especializados de fluidos de perfuração e completação incluindo: determinação dos tipos e pesos de fluidos a serem utilizados nas intervenções (perfuração, completação, avaliação, workover e abandono), realização de simulações específicas para os projetos de fluidos;

  • Atualização de projetos especializados da disciplina de fluidos;

  • Realizar suporte técnico à operação durante a intervenção;

  • Realizar relatório final de fluidos para as intervenções concluídas com levantamento de lições aprendidas ocorridas;

  • Consolidação de dados de entrada para elaboração dos projetos;

  • Cálculos de parâmetros hidráulicos e de carreamento de sólidos envolvidos nas operações com fluidos aquosos e não aquosos em regime permanente;

  • Cálculos de parâmetros hidráulicos e térmicos envolvidos no escoamento de fluidos aquosos e não aquosos em regime transiente;

  • Cálculos envolvendo a solubilidade de formações salinas;

  • Cálculos envolvendo o dimensionamento do peso fluido em função da fluência de formações salinas;

  • Cálculos que avaliam a influência da pressão e da temperatura na massa especificam dos fluidos;

  • Cálculos preditivos a respeito da possibilidade de formação de hidratos;

  • Projeto de Fluidos de Perfuração;

  • Projeto de Fluidos de Completação;

  • Projeto de Fluidos de Restauração;

  • Projeto de Fluidos de Avaliação;

  • Participação em reuniões operacionais;

  • Atividades de suporte a projetos;

  • Preenchimento de orçamento em sistema;

  • Realização de retroanálise dos projetos elaborados após operações;

  • Prestar serviço de análise, suporte, revisão e/ou elaboração de documentos técnicos (notas, pareceres e relatórios técnicos) na área de fluidos de perfuração e completação e seus correlatos;

  • Obtenção e revisão de informações técnicas em banco de dados, por meio digital, por acesso a documentação em arquivos físicos/papel ou pela consulta a áreas técnicas, para revisão e estruturação de dados em sistemas específicos visando atendimento a requisitos regulatórios diversos;

  • Prestar suporte, realizar levantamento e tratamento estatístico de dados, consolidar dados gerados para auxiliar na gestão técnica da disciplina de fluidos de perfuração e completação, incluindo aspectos das questões ambientais associadas aos temas;

  • Dar suporte à elaboração e/ou revisão de documentos técnicos diversos para órgãos reguladores e licenciadores no tocante à disciplina de fluidos de perfuração e de completação, controle e extração de sólidos;

  • Prestar suporte técnico na condução e governança de grupos temáticos das disciplinas em tela, incluindo e não se limitando a: elaboração de atas de reunião, convocação e agendamento de reuniões, preenchimento de informações técnicas em sistema de suporte à gestão, participação em grupos de trabalhos;

  • Propor, elaborar e executar revisões em procedimentos de diretrizes técnicas associados ao tema de fluidos de perfuração e de completação e correlatos;

  • Dar suporte à condução, ao planejamento e ao acompanhamento de ações de pesquisa, desenvolvimento e inovação nas áreas de fluidos de perfuração, completação e gestão ambiental das operações com fluidos;

  • Contribuir na elaboração e/ou revisão de especificação técnica de serviços, produtos e/ou equipamentos associados a operações com fluidos de perfuração e completação;

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação: Ensino Superior em Engenharia Química ou Química
  • Experiência: Em projeto e/ou execução de perfuração de poços de petróleo offshore, na área de fluidos de perfuração e completação e experiência na área de poços de petróleo offshore, nas atividades de projeto de fluidos de perfuração e completação.
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos: Domínio das atividades de fluidos de perfuração e completação; Competência de Dados: tratamento, transferência, coleta, organização, agrupamento, noções de análise estatística, árvore de decisão; Pacote Office: Word, Excel, Power Point; Power BI: Noções, filtros, organização dos dados, pesquisa. Operação básica com dados; Noções de projeto de poço marítimo; Noções de equipamentos de sondas; Noções de orçamentação de poços; Noções básicas dos tipos de completação (contenção de areia, completações simples e inteligentes, etc); Noções básicas de caracterização de reservatório (geologia, geofísica e avaliação de reservatórios);

title: Dynamics 365 CE Senior Technical Architect
description:
Our client's Microsoft Business Solutions team is a Microsoft Gold Partner and leader in Microsoft software implementations for medium to large organisations, providing their clients with the ability to keep up with the ever-changing digital world by implementing Microsoft's Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Customer Engagement (CE) software from the Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) software line.

Role Overview

The Dynamics CE & Power Platform Senior Technical Architect is a core team member of our client's customer delivery of Microsoft Dynamics 365 centred solutions. The STA will be involved in the business processes and solution design and will be hands on configuring and customising the implementation of Dynamics CE & Power Platform solutions working with both onshore and offshore development teams. The position may require business travel.

Job Location: Silema, Malta

Work Type: Hybrid

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Working Hours: GMT +1

Salary: Base + Benefits (Paid in Euros €)

Relocation: VISA & Relocation Package Included

Requirements

  • A University graduate with relevant degree within a computing or business discipline;
  • Microsoft Dynamics CRM Certifications (2016, D365) AND/OR Power Platform Certifications are desirable;
  • Strong technical & functional knowledge and understanding of Microsoft Dynamics CRM and/or Power Platform technology stack covering a wide spectrum of industries and sectors;
  • Minimum 12+ years of proven experience in IT which includes end to end implementation experience in either of Dynamics CRM / Power Platform solutions;
  • Strong and proven experience in developing solutions that involve Power Platform (including Power Apps like Canvas, Model driven etc., Power Automate, Power BI etc.);
  • Strong understanding of all areas within Customer Engagement including Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, Field Services, and Project Service;
  • Good understanding of Dataverse including customisations and development of Business Data Models for different solutions etc.;
  • Good understand of Microsoft Dynamics CRM Accelerators, industry templates and add-ons;
  • Proven track record of successful maintenance or end to end implementation of a number of solutions for medium/ large customers, preferably across a number of business verticals (e.g. healthcare, finance, insurance etc.);
  • Proven ability to develop a clear understanding of clients' needs and the ability to incorporate them into a solution following effective design approach;
  • Experience of consultancy roles in software delivery;
  • Experience in a delivery-orientated IT environment using waterfall, agile and DevOps methodologies;
  • Adept at business requirement analysis, solution design, development, system verification and deployment strategies;
  • Ability to see the bigger picture and suggest solutions both within and outside the current implementation;
  • Experience in creation of demos, supporting pre-sales activities is an advantage;
  • Business process mapping, Fit Gap analysis, work package estimation, work breakdown structure, modelling and documentation knowledge;
  • Excellent understanding of Dynamics CRM DB Schema and Business Data Model including the customisation and development of Business Data Models for different solutions;
  • Broad understanding of software development lifecycle, development management, release management, data migrations, cut-over planning and hypercare support;
  • Knowledge of Azure DevOps & CI/CD is a plus;
  • Knowledge and understanding of .NET framework including extensive experience writing ASP.NET and C# code (not just limited to plugins/custom workflows) is a plus;

Responsibilities

The CE Senior Technical Architect will work with the Consulting Services department to implement various modules of D365 CE (including Power Platform) working closely with client teams and business stakeholders.

  • Organise, execute, manage and document workshops, meetings and requirements sessions with the client representatives, project stakeholders, business analysts and consulting team;
  • Interface effectively with other members of the consulting team to arrive at best in class solution, and provide a sustainable and scalable solution architecture and application to meet client's requirements;
  • Deliver high quality business and software solutions & services to clients ensuring the implementation of best practices based on Microsoft Dynamics standards and supported configuration/ customizations;
  • Ensure completeness in meeting business requirements and take accountability for project deliverables including and not limited to project documentation, solution design, performance, reliability, testing features etc;
  • Deliver all consultancy and configuration work according to our project methodology, ensuring that all software applications are implemented successfully according to the SLA: on time and on budget;
  • Maximize usage of OOB features and provide technical design or develop/customize solution approach for identified gaps;
  • Contribute to activities as required including technical presales, building demo and proof of concept solutions for various client presentations. Proactively skilling up on new versions and technology stack to be future ready;
  • Work on the creation of Dynamics 365 solutions and industry templates;
  • Meet and exceed customer expectations of business knowledge, skills and behaviour;
  • Be a trusted advisor for our clients and help to provide solutions which can be upgrade ready;
  • Proactively identify business/ project/ technical/ support risks and provide suggestions to mitigate or communicate as necessary;
  • Proactively communicate progress updates to relevant parties both formally and informally;
  • Support practice development activities such as defining, solutioning and configuring industry specific solutions;
  • Be an active member of technical and design working groups within the practice;
  • In all activities, ensure timely completion of internal processes and mandatory trainings;
  • Drive for process improvement, feature reusability and other initiatives to maximize efficiency in delivery;
  • Carry out additional duties as may occur from time to time as instructed and agreed by the management team or supervisors;
  • Provide guidance and mentorship (technical/professional) to groom other team members;
  • Represent our client's Microsoft Business Solutions team in a professional and positive manner at all times;
  • A portion of the role also requires supporting and doing people management, people development & career progression support, performance assessment and management;
  • The Employee is required to follow our client's Information Security Policies (ISP and ISMP) at all times;

Whether it's great training and development, mobility opportunities or corporate responsibility volunteering activities – you'll gain a wealth of experiences on which to build a rewarding career. Our client is a firm that encourages you to be yourself, values your contribution, and inspires you to act as a role model, always focused on doing the right thing for each other, our clients, and our communities.

This sets out all the different ways you'll be rewarded at our client. Among other things, you can benefit from honest conversations about your career as well as a range of other rewards. In all these ways and more, they have created an environment that can bring out the best in you.

#Bethechange and #makethechange. Join our talented, successful team and make the leap into the future.

title: auxiliar administrativo
description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II.
A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.
Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.
O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.
Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Auxiliar na execução das rotinas Administrativas da Área, bem como prestar suporte aos demais membros da equipe quando necessário.
Requisitos e qualificações
Ensino médio completo;
Experiência em rotinas administrativas e/ou atendimento ao público.
Informações adicionais
Local: Santa Cruz - Rio de Janeiro;
Escala: 12 horas de trabalho X 36 horas de descanso.

title: auxiliar de saúde bucal esf
description:
A
SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina
é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos , de 04/03/1966, de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,
Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS)
e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
Desempenhar as atividades sob a supervisão de um dentista, auxiliando o profissional em seu atendimento de consultório, desenvolvendo atividades de odontologia sanitária e compondo equipe de saúde em nível local, a fim de dar apoio às atividades próprias do profissional de odontologia.

  • Curso de Auxiliar de Saúde Bucal Completo;

title: Sr Software Engineer, Frontend
description:
About The Role
Please note: this hybrid position is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil - welcoming both local professionals and those open to relocating.
At Uber, Frontend Engineers build web experiences that power the way people move and receive things around the world. As part of our engineering team, you'll work on large-scale applications that impact millions of users.

You'll collaborate with cross-functional partners (design, backend, data science, product). Your work will help shape the future of Uber's Delivery, defining how people interact with Uber on the web.

About The Team
The Delivery team is focused on innovating and streamlining how products and services reach our customers. In this role, you'll contribute to building efficient and robust systems that support order processing, logistics, and real-time tracking. Your contributions will help optimize the end-to-end delivery experience, making it more reliable and seamless for both drivers and customers.

What You'll Do

  • Design and implement user-facing features for critical web properties at scale, making engineering trade-offs between speed, maintainability, and user experience.
  • Own the technical design and execution of features, from initial architecture discussions to debugging production issues.
  • Collaborate across disciplines, Product, Design, Data Science, and Backend Engineering, to turn ambiguous business needs into clear, scalable front-end systems.
  • Champion front-end engineering excellence, defining and leading the adoption of code health, testing, and design standards within your project area.
  • Improve core application performance, efficiency, and system reliability, proactively identifying and tackling areas of technical debt in software and processes within your team.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on best practices, system design philosophy, and navigating cross-functional project dynamics.

What You'll Need

  • 7 years of professional software engineering experience, with a focus on large-scale, high-traffic web applications.
  • Hands-on experience and proficiency in a modern web framework such as JavaScript, React, VueJS, or Angular, plus HTML and CSS.
  • Proficiency in fundamental algorithms and data structures, including hash tables, trees, stacks, queues, linked lists, DFS, and BFS.
  • Demonstrated understanding of modern web application architecture and design patterns, and their implications for performance and scalability.
  • Advanced English communication skills, written and verbal, to effectively collaborate with globally distributed cross-functional teams.

Bonus Points If

  • Experience leading the technical direction of complex, cross-functional projects with multiple dependencies.
  • Familiarity with back-end systems (e.g., Go, Python, TypeScript) to facilitate collaboration and diagnose full-stack issues.
  • Experience with the full project lifecycle, from idea inception and stakeholder engagement to monitoring in production.

title: Head of Event Services
description:
Department: Events & Entertainment
Location: Brazil
Description
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
THE POSITION
The Head of Event Services shall have dual reporting to the Event Services Director in FIFA HQ Zurich and to the Executive Operations Director. Under the leadership of the FIFA HQ team, they shall ensure the successful operational planning, management and implementation of the Accommodation, Travel, Logistics, Transport and Guest Operations projects for the FIFA Women's World Cup ("FWWC").
The Head of Event Services will work together with the Event Services Team in FIFA HQ Zurich to ensure:
1. Drive FIFA's leadership in Event Services, encompassing the above areas.
2. Ensure suitable and efficient business models and processes for operation across multiple different events, of different scales, simultaneously, across all areas under auspice.
3. Continuously assess and propose improvements to the requirements and regulations for the services. Integrate these enhancements into the Master Project Plans and detailed budgets, ensuring stakeholder alignment and cost-effective delivery for each event within the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 project.
4. Follow the trends of the industry to be ready to anticipate changes in a responsible and timely manner.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Operational Excellence and Project Delivery:
Plan and execute projects and services, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget, while maintaining high-quality standards.
Serve as the primary point of contact for the Executive Operations Director regarding all service-related matters, representing the Director on various occasions as needed.
Develop and implement efficient project plans and procedures for all tournaments and events in collaboration with other Subdivisions, ensuring seamless execution.
Collaboration and Team Integration:
Contribute to the overall success of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027as an active member of the management team, fostering strong collaboration across FIFA27.
Ensure the Event Services department consistently delivers high-quality services to tournament project teams, positioning itself as a key service provider.
Collaborate with other departments to share responsibility for the FWWC's overall success, ensuring alignment with broader goals and objectives, and maintaining a focus on the big picture.
Stakeholder Engagement and Networking:
Cultivate close cooperation with staff members across all divisions to ensure an exceptional user experience (UX). This includes coordinating with FIFA stakeholders, local FIFA subsidiaries, stadium/venue owners, host associations, local authorities, and third-party partners to create optimal conditions.
Share relevant information within the FIFA27 and with other internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective communication and collaboration
YOUR PROFILE
Independent and Flexible: Ability to lead large teams independently in complex environments, and situations with ambiguity
Effective Communication and Trust Building: Skilled in fostering open communication and creating an environment of trust. Capable of understanding and addressing the needs and expectations of others, identifying and resolving conflicts, and delivering impactful presentations. Experienced negotiator in an international context
Client-Centric Approach: Consistently demonstrates respect and professionalism toward clients (colleagues, superiors, member associations, clubs, etc.). Clearly defines and aligns expectations, ensuring client needs are met and exceeded. Receives positive client feedback, builds strong, trusting relationships, and anticipates client needs. Maintains a flexible and innovative mindset in service delivery
Leadership and Team Development: Respected leader within the team, setting ambitious objectives and motivating staff to achieve them. Inspires collaboration and fosters a high-performance culture. Well-regarded by peers and top management, adapting goals to client needs and driving continuous improvement. Effectively manages pressure, supports team growth, and handles challenges with strong interpersonal and conflict-resolution skills
Strategic Thinking: Demonstrates the ability to assess the broader impact of organizational decisions and developments, anticipating their consequences.
Decisive Action and Risk Management: Recognizes situations that require swift, pragmatic decision-making. Takes initiative, explores various solutions, and is willing to take calculated risks. Acts promptly and decisively in response to unexpected challenges.
Planning and Resource Management: Skilled in developing detailed, chronological plans, setting priorities, and allocating resources effectively. Implements systems for tracking progress and control, and adapts plans as needed to achieve objectives. Maintains a strong focus on reporting and accountability.
Collaboration in a Multi-National Team: Leads and collaborates effectively in diverse, cross-cultural teams. Navigates cultural differences, fosters inclusivity, and ensures seamless communication across global teams, driving alignment and achieving shared goals.
A minimum sports event management experience of 5 years, ideally on an international level in the Event Services (Accommodation, Travel, Logistics, Transport and Guest Operations).
Extensive knowledge of event and sport facility operations
Strong knowledge of event planning and event project management processes
Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
Ability to effectively monitor organisational performance and implement decisive corrective actions
Right to work in Brazil.

Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro soon.

description:

Atuar em todas as etapas do ciclo de dados:ingerir, transformar, modelar e analisar informações. Criar e manter camadas de dados otimizadas para visualizações e relatórios. Automatizar fluxos de dados priorizando eficiência, escalabilidade e facilidade de manutenção. Trabalhar com estruturas particionadas no BigQuery, otimizando performance em ambientes analíticos. Definir, acompanhar e validar métricas operacionais em parceria com os times de negócio. title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Company overview:

Blue Orange Digital is a boutique data & AI consultancy that delivers enterprise-grade results. We design and build modern data platforms, analytics, and ML/AI Agent solutions for mid‑market and enterprise clients across Private Equity, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Retail.

Our teams work with technologies like Databricks, Snowflake, dbt, and the broader Microsoft ecosystem to turn messy, real-world data into trustworthy, actionable insight.

We're a builder‑led, client‑first culture that prizes ownership, clear communication, and shipping high‑impact work.

Note: Please submit your resume in English, as all application materials must be in English for review and consideration.

Position Overview:

Blue Orange is seeking an expert-level Machine Learning Engineer to address expanding opportunities, serving as a leader in LLM Engineering and Agentic AI. This senior role requires a candidate with extensive experience in the end-to-end ML/AI cycle, MLOps, LLMs, and a proven track record of designing and deploying complex, cloud-native data and ML/AI solutions. The candidate will mentor others and influence technical strategy.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and productionization of machine learning, ML ops, traditional AI, LLMs, and agentic AI solutions into scalable, product-driven applications, serving as a technical expert.

  • Drive the implementation of complex application integrations to leverage and deploy machine learning, ML ops, traditional AI, LLMs, and agentic AI products.

  • Define and implement architectural solutions that ensure the delivery speed and scalability of product and data pipelines.

  • Lead the adoption of managed and serverless cloud offerings to create performant and scalable cloud-native application solutions and data pipelines.

  • Lead the implementation of advanced machine learning models including regression, classification, Bayesian methods, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and advanced Agentic AI architectures.

  • Serve as a technical leader to integrate prompt engineering and RAG components into production systems, ensuring seamless and robust deployment.

  • Serve as a key resource in client-facing consulting, driving customer engagement and influencing technical solutions for clients.

  • Stay up to date with the latest advancements in prompt engineering, RAG, data science, machine learning, and AI technologies, exploring innovative approaches to enhance machine learning, ML ops, traditional AI, LLMs, and agentic AI capabilities across the organization.

Requirements:

  • 7+ years of industry experience as a hands-on practitioner in ML/AI, Data Science, or LLM/AI Engineering and proven experience with cloud offerings.

  • 5+ years of experience with cloud platforms such as AWS.

  • Extensive experience with the end-to-end ML/AI cycle, MLOps, and LLMs.

  • Expertise in advanced machine learning techniques, data analytics, and feature engineering.

  • Experience with NLP and LLM-based technologies and frameworks.

  • Mastery of Python and advanced proficiency in SQL.

  • Expertise in 3–5 major cloud and data platforms and exposure to all (AWS, GCP, Azure, Snowflake, and Databricks).

  • Self-driven and autonomous with excellent problem-solving skills and critical thinking.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders effectively.

  • Proven ability to lead customer engagement and influence technical direction in a consulting environment.

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications (for Senior Role):

  • Advanced degree in a relevant field.

  • Publications in relevant AI/ML communities and journals.

  • Experience fine-tuning LLMs and deploying them (e.g., using MLFlow) a plus.

Benefits:

  • Fully remote

  • Flexible Schedule

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • Paid parental/bereavement leave

  • Worldwide recognized clients to build skills for an excellent resume

  • Top-notch team to learn and grow with

Salary: USD $9,486 (adjustable based on experience)

Background checks may be required for certain positions/projects.

Blue Orange Digital is an equal-opportunity employer.

A ArcelorMittal é a empresa líder mundial de aço e mineração, com presença em 60 países e instalações de siderurgia primária em 17 países. Em 2022, a ArcelorMittal teve receita de US $ 79,8 bilhões e produção de aço bruto de 71,5 milhões de toneladas métricas, enquanto a produção de minério de ferro atingiu 58,0 milhões de toneladas métricas. Com o aço em nosso núcleo, nosso pessoal criativo e uma cultura empreendedora em mente, apoiaremos o mundo nessa mudança. Isso é o que acreditamos ser necessário para ser a empresa siderúrgica do futuro. title: Gerente de TI
description:
POR QUE SER UM VOLTALIEN?
Na Voltalia somos apaixonados pela ideia de um mundo mais sustentável, limpo e inclusivo Acima de tudo buscamos fazer a diferença nas regiões onde atuamos, pois somos uma empresa orientada para nossa missão de melhorar o meio ambiente global, promovendo o desenvolvimento local.
Nossos Valores são: Integridade, Destreza, Empreendedorismo e Espírito de Equipe. Dentro dessas premissas o respeito nos norteia, por isso, para todas as nossas vagas, valorizamos a diversidade em sua amplitude independente de cor, religião, idade, deficiência, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero.
Nascemos em 2005 na França e atualmente somos uma empresa de capital aberto na Euronext Paris. Estamos em 20 países, divididos em 4 continentes e oferecemos capacidade operacional global aos nossos clientes.
Atuamos como produtores de energia eólica, solar, hidro, biomassa e soluções de armazenamento. Somos também prestadores de serviços à terceiros como Desenvolvimento, EPC, O&M e Distribuição.
#proudtobeVoltalia
#renewableenergy
O nosso time do TI está buscando um(a) Gerente de TI para apoiar a equipe nas atividades da área, tais como:
O QUE ESPERAR DO SEU DIA A DIA
Coordenar as operações de TI locais e fornecer suporte técnico eficiente aos usuários na América Latina.
Gerenciar e integrar soluções de TI corporativas, incluindo o ERP Oracle e outras soluções críticas de negócios em nível local e do Grupo.
Supervisionar a Tecnologia Operacional (TO) e sua conectividade com os sistemas de TI, promovendo eficiência e segurança nas operações industriais.
Garantir a proteção contra ameaças cibernéticas e a conformidade regulatória sob a responsabilidade do nosso Diretor de Segurança da Informação do Grupo.
Gestão Financeira: Planejar e controlar o orçamento de TI, garantindo a alocação eficiente de recursos e o alinhamento com a estratégia da empresa.
Avaliar e negociar contratos com fornecedores de tecnologia, buscando soluções inovadoras e otimização de custos.
Liderar equipes de Operações e Soluções, promovendo o crescimento profissional e o treinamento.
Gerenciar a aquisição, manutenção e controle de ativos de TI, incluindo equipamentos, softwares e infraestrutura.
Apoiar projetos de inovação tecnológica para aprimorar a eficiência operacional e a competitividade dos negócios.
A ENERGIA QUE PRECISAMOS
Bacharelado em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas afins
Mínimo de 8 anos de experiência na área de TI, incluindo ERP, cibersegurança, TO e gestão financeira, sendo 3 anos como gerente ou coordenador
Conhecimento avançado em governança de TI, frameworks de cibersegurança e otimização de custos
Pós-graduação em Gestão de TI, Segurança da Informação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas afins
Experiência em gestão de custos e investimentos em tecnologia, incluindo otimização de contratos e licenciamento de software
Certificações desejáveis em Finanças de TI (como FinOps), Segurança da Informação (CISSP, CISM) ou Gestão de TI (ITIL, PMP ou SCRUM)
Conhecimento em IoT, automação industrial e tecnologias emergentes para otimização operacional
A FONTE DE ENERGIA QUE PRECISAMOS
Excelentes habilidades de liderança e gestão de pessoas
Forte capacidade de comunicação, negociação e relacionamento interpessoal, com habilidade para interagir com stakeholders em todos os níveis em um ambiente multicultural
Foco no cliente final e na otimização de recursos
Capacidade de planejamento financeiro e tomada de decisões bem fundamentadas
Comprometimento e proatividade
Abordagem prática com capacidade para lidar com um grande volume de tarefas
Trabalho em equipe, Empreendedorismo, Integridade e Inovação são valores requeridos para todos os colaboradores do grupo e, é claro, ser gente boa
COMO VIVEMOS AQUI
Nossa energia de startup está presente no dia a dia, por meio do trabalho em equipe em um ambiente descontraído, criativo e sustentável
Aqui na Voltalia, ousamos em renovar. Buscamos trabalhar de maneira unida e diversa porque acreditamos que, dessa forma, desenhamos nossa essência em cada projeto realizado.
Voltaliens são a nossa maior energia Por isso, pensamos diariamente em nosso desenvolvimento. Temos o foco em soluções porque temos um objetivo em comum: melhorar o nosso ecossistema.
Vamos?

title: D&TD Technology Consultant
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat relocation package.
Overview:
We are seeking a Technology Consultant to join Global Manufacturing Excellence Digitalization and Technology Division(D&TD).
Global Manufacturing Excellence is the recognized Center of Excellence driving value across Saudi Aramco's Downstream Global manufacturing portfolio. D&TD is responsible for leading the technology function collaborating across various downstream functions and corporate as well.
Your primary role is to support the development and deployment of technology management programs aimed at providing technical support across Saudi Aramco Global Manufacturing portfolio. You will ideate, introduce, deploy and sustain novel and innovative technological solutions within various domains including reliability, maintenance, sustainability, energy and process.
Key Responsibilities:
As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:
Lead the end-to-end implementation of Technologies across the downstream portfolio including petrochemical facilities, refineries, terminals and bulk plants as well as gas plants.
Develop comprehensive value adding technology roadmaps aligned to business challenges such as energy optimization, sustainability, plant availability, debottlenecking and process optimization.
Accelerate technology deployment working closely with internal and external execution agencies and vendors.
Conduct feasibility studies including technical and economic evaluation of solutions, platforms, and new technologies.
Perform technologies scouting to enable the identification of innovative and value adding technologies.
Develop business case and cost/benefit analysis for technologies deployment.
Work with other consultants, engineers, and project managers to deliver comprehensive solutions that address both technical and business requirements.
Prepare reports and presentations to communicate the progress and benefits of technology initiatives to peers, relevant stakeholders and senior management.
Collaborate with technology providers in developing and conducting tailored training content and programs to support the implementation and adoption of technologies by end-users.
Recognize and introduce necessary changes to standards and governance.
Stay abreast of global and regional Oil and Gas industry trends, market conditions, and regulatory changes that may impact technology implementations.
Ensure compliance with corporate governance and standards, evaluate solution implementations. And identify necessary changes to standards and governance.
Minimum Requirements:
You will hold a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related field (Chemical, Industrial, Electrical, and Mechanical Engineering). A Masters' degree is preferred.
You will have 10-15 years of experience as a Technology Consultant ideating, scouting, introducing and tracking value added technology deployment.
You have good understanding of downstream technologies, including but not limited to refinery processes.
You will have experience in developing business case and benefit/cost analysis for downstream technology.
You will have experience in working collaboratively in cross-functional teams, across the project lifecycle fostering effective communication and cooperation.
You will be able to demonstrate excellent understanding of management of change, engineering and design package as well as regulatory, risk mitigation and safety requirements.
You will have experience in change management, including developing and implementing technology changes.
You will be able to demonstrate understanding of relevant industry energy, safety and design regulations and standards ensuring compliance of proposed technology solutions.
You will be able to demonstrate excellent understanding of manufacturing technology solutions enabling the key process areas including production, reliability, environmental, safety and sustainability
You will have strong project management skills with a proven track record of successfully leading and delivering complex technology implementation projects in the O&G business
You have the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders at all levels
Working environment:
Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.
At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.
We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.
Aramco energizes the world economy.
Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.
With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.
Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.
We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

We're building the definitive platform for intentional living, connecting people with inspiring experiences in fitness, wellness, and beyond. title: FIFA Fan Festival Manager
description:
Department: Tournament and Venue Operations
Location: Brazil
Description
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
THE POSITION
The FIFA Fan Festival Manager will play support the operational delivery of the FIFA Fan Festival across all Host Cities in Brazil for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027. Working directly with the FIFA Fan Festival Senior Manager and the FIFA Fan Festival Team in Zurich, the role will help ensure consistent delivery across all Host Cities by supporting stakeholder coordination, infrastructure implementation and on-site readiness. The position requires a detail-oriented and hands-on professional with strong communication and project coordination skills, as well as the flexibility to adapt in a dynamic, large-scale event environment.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Planning & Oversight Support
Assist the FIFA Fan Festival Senior Manager to steer the operational delivery of the FIFA Fan Festival.
Contribute to the implementation and roll-out of the FIFA Fan Festival programme across Host Cities.
Support the development and delivery of operational documentation, site plans, and reporting.
Stakeholder Coordination & Support
Assist in managing relationships with key stakeholders including Host Cities, Host Countries and agencies.
Coordinate with local organisers to ensure the timely implementation of FIFA requirements.
Participate in meetings, workshops, and inspections with internal and external stakeholders.
Event Delivery & Infrastructure
Support the development of site design and technical infrastructure requirements.
Help monitor local delivery of core infrastructure and report on site readiness.
Oversee correct usage of FIFA's event marks and branding implementation in coordination with the Senior Manager.
Project & Team Coordination
Coordinate and support the sourcing, onboarding and supervision of local FIFA Fan Festival Venue Managers.
Ensure accurate tracking and reporting of progress, issues and milestones across multiple venues.
Assist in planning, documenting and executing site inspections, briefing sessions and operational weeks.
Reporting
Support the FIFA Fan Festival Senior Manager in adapting to changing project scopes and resolving issues.
Contribute to identifying risks and developing contingency plans.
YOUR PROFILE
Education & Languages
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Project Management or a related field.
Fluent in Portuguese and English (spoken and written).
Technical Skills
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (PowerPoint, Excel, Word).
Strong digital and documentation skills.
Professional Experience
Minimum 3 years' experience in operational marketing, project delivery or event management, ideally in a sports context.
Previous engagement with governmental or municipal stakeholders is a plus.
Understanding of the dynamics of large-scale public or sports events.
Core Competencies
Highly self-motivated with the ability to work independently within a structured team.
Excellent attention to detail and accuracy across multiple projects and deadlines.
Advanced communication and documentation skills, with a proactive follow-up mindset.
Resilient under pressure, with a high level of flexibility and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to work evenings, weekends, and travel frequently across Host Cities.
Requirements
Right to work in Brazil.
Fluent in English (spoken and written)
Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Job Overview
We are seeking a highly experienced Org & Mgmt Specialist to join the Organizational Consulting Department (OCD) within the HR & Corporate Services organization.
The OCD department plays a key role in strategy execution, operating model design, organization effectiveness, transformation advisory, corporate governance, and complex program delivery.
As a trusted advisor to senior leaders, you will shape enterprise-wide Operating Model Transformation solutions, drive alignment across business lines, and enable the successful execution of strategic initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Lead high-impact operating model and organization design engagements across diverse business entities.
Assess current-state organizational structures and design future-state spans of control, governance, workflows, and decision rights.
Develop standardized frameworks, methodologies, and toolkits for operating model and organization design projects.
Provide executive-level advisory services on strategy, transformation, and organizational effectiveness.
Prepare and deliver presentations, briefing notes, and strategic recommendations for senior leadership.
Design and facilitate workshops to drive alignment and support decision-making at executive levels.
Develop and implement corporate governance frameworks balancing standardization with business flexibility.
Drive group-wide operating model alignment including affiliates, joint ventures, and international operations.
Oversee post-merger integration (PMI) activities, ensuring operational and cultural alignment of acquired entities.
Develop, refine, and deploy enterprise playbooks, operating principles, and organizational guidelines.
Conduct benchmarking, market studies, and research to inform structural, strategic, and operational decisions.
Provide strategic counsel to leaders navigating organizational change, growth, risk mitigation, or restructuring.
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, Engineering, or related discipline; Master's degree preferred.
Minimum 12 years of experience in management consulting, with deep expertise in operating models, organization design, PMI, governance, or transformation.
Proven ability to manage large-scale consulting initiatives within complex, multinational organizations.
Strong command of organization design and process improvement methodologies and tools.
Exceptional communication, persuasion, and stakeholder engagement skills, including executive presence.
High proficiency in analytical thinking, problem-solving, and applying structured approaches to complex challenges.
Experience operating in fast-paced environments with high ambiguity.
Ability to influence senior leadership and drive alignment across cross-functional and global teams.
Working environment
Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.
We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.
Aramco energizes the world economy.
Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.
With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.
Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

description:
O que estamos procurando?
Principais Atribuições
Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo alinhamento contínuo com os objetivos de negócio e maximização de valor entregue.
Atuar no planejamento, refinamento e acompanhamento das entregas, colaborando com times multidisciplinares desde a concepção até a entrega das soluções.
Trabalhar de forma próxima aos stakeholders, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em requisitos claros, bem definidos e priorizáveis.
Contribuir ativamente para a definição da visão do produto e roadmap, orientando decisões com base em valor, impacto no negócio e capacidade do time.
Aplicar práticas de governança ágil, garantindo cadência, previsibilidade e transparência nas entregas.
Definir, acompanhar e analisar KPIs e métricas de produto e agilidade, avaliando desempenho, fluxo de valor e impacto das entregas nos resultados do negócio.
Atuar na gestão do fluxo de valor (Value Stream), identificando gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria contínua.
Promover a melhoria contínua dos processos, apoiando iniciativas de otimização, automação e evolução da forma de trabalho.
Equilibrar demandas estratégicas e operacionais, conciliando necessidades do negócio com sustentabilidade e evolução do produto no longo prazo.
Requisitos
Experiência comprovada como Product Owner, atuando em ambientes ágeis.
Sólido conhecimento em Agilidade, com vivência prática em frameworks como Scrum, Kanban, SAFe ou similares.
Perfil híbrido entre Produto e Agilidade, com forte atuação em priorização, refinamento de backlog e geração de valor.
Experiência na definição de requisitos, histórias de usuário e critérios de aceite.
Vivência com KPIs, métricas de produto e indicadores de agilidade (ex.: lead time, throughput, valor entregue).
Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções claras, atuando como elo entre stakeholders e times de entrega.
Boa comunicação, senso de dono e habilidade para negociação e tomada de decisão.
Mentalidade orientada a dados, melhoria contínua e colaboração.
Localização desta posição: Hibrido no Rio de Janeiro, RJ.
Por que construir sua carreira na Meta?
Oferecemos autonomia, objetivos claros e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, onde os profissionais têm a oportunidade de interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias e trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) de qualquer lugar do mundo. Além disso, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil segundo o Great Place to Work e uma das 10 empresas de tecnologia que mais crescem no país por 3 anos consecutivos, segundo o Anuário Informático Hoje.
Quais são os nossos valores?
Somos pessoas servindo pessoas
Todos nós pensamos e agimos como donos
Estamos famintos por desempenho
Crescemos e aprendemos juntos
Buscamos excelência e simplicidade
Temos inovação e criatividade em nosso DNA
Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, independentemente de sua condição, deficiência, etnia, crença religiosa, orientação sexual, aparência, idade ou outras. Queremos que você cresça conosco em um ambiente acolhedor e cheio de oportunidades.

SOBRE A PANDORA

Transformamos Histórias em Joias

Sediada em Copenhague e com produção artesanal na Tailândia, a Pandora é a maior joalheria do mundo. Somos famosos por nossos braceletes e charms icônicos, além de coleções exclusivas de anéis, brincos e colares — tudo elaborado à mão com materiais de altíssima qualidade.

Nossos Valores

Guiamos nossas ações através de quatro pilares:

We Dream: Somos visionários e olhamos além.

We Dare: Buscamos ambições ousadas com coragem.

We Care: Cuidamos uns dos outros, dos clientes e do planeta.

We Deliver: Entregamos resultados e cumprimos promessas.

A Fênix faz parte da Arquiconsult, uma empresa consolidada com ampla experiência no mercado internacional e forte parceria com a Microsoft. Com operações em países como Brasil, Estados Unidos, Espanha, Portugal e diversos outros, a Fênix é referência em projetos Microsoft e soluções em Microsoft Business Applications. title: Gerente de Turno
description:
DESCRIPTION


A equipe da Amazon Logística está em busca de um(a) Gerente de Turno da Noite para se juntar à equipe da AMZL Brasil em nossa Delivery Station de Rio de Janeiro-RJ.
Como Gerente de Turno, você será responsável pela operação noturna em uma Estação de Entrega, fornecendo liderança para Líderes de Equipe, Operadores e Prestadores de Serviços de Entrega, gerenciando relacionamentos e desempenho de agências externas. Você trabalhará em um ambiente altamente colaborativo que é mais semelhante a uma start-up do que a uma grande empresa. A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas. Você precisará prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico. Se você tem um histórico focado na qualidade e obcecado pelo cliente, que carrega consigo a experiência de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico, em constante mudança e ambíguo, adoraríamos ouvir sua opinião. A função envolve:

  • Estar baseado em um de nossos postos de entrega, no turno da noite. A Amazon opera 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, portanto, o trabalho em turnos fará parte dessa função, incluindo finais de semana e feriados.
  • Supervisão da operação que foca na entrega de pedidos da Amazon direto aos clientes
  • Apoiar sua equipe de líderes operacionais na gestão diária do posto de entrega. Isso incluirá alocação de mão de obra, liderança de reuniões, atribuição de tarefas e comunicação com fornecedores internos e externos.
  • Trabalhar com KPIs como On Time Dispatch, First Day Delivery Success e melhorar o atendimento ao cliente.
  • Pensar analiticamente sobre gerenciamento de projetos com atenção aos detalhes, capacidade de influenciar os outros e habilidades organizacionais excepcionais.
  • Ser obcecado por métricas e mergulhar fundo para encontrar as causas raízes rapidamente para gerar melhorias.
  • Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos sem sacrificar a qualidade ou a funcionalidade principal. Utilizando habilidades excepcionais de resolução de problemas e comunicação para influenciar o público comercial e técnico.
  • Fornecer suporte diário durante a implantação/implementação de novos sistemas/processos e coletar feedback.
  • Mapeamento de requisitos de negócios, entendimento de processos de negócios, estudo e análise de fluxos de trabalho e desenho de soluções.
  • Utilizar continuamente ferramentas de software e hardware para garantir operações normais do dia a dia. Garantir que os associados tenham as ferramentas adequadas para realizar o trabalho e coordenar o reparo ou substituição quando necessário.
  • Comunicar métricas diárias e relatar exceções a outros departamentos de Operações e em toda a Amazon, conforme necessário.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • equivalent, or High school diploma
  • Experience within a manufacturing or production environment
  • Experience with performance metrics and process improvement and Lean techniques
  • Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Speak, write, and read fluently in English
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or experience in Engineering, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field
  • Experience working with changing priorities and schedules
  • Experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects, or experience in multiple finance and accounting roles

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

About the Team:

​Descrição da Empresa:

A Pedaço de Céu Foto Pet é um estúdio especializado em fotografia pet e família multiespécie, criado para transformar vínculos reais em memórias que atravessam o tempo.

Acreditamos que cada pet tem uma essência única e que o amor entre tutores e seus companheiros merece ser registrado com sensibilidade, calma e respeito.

Nosso trabalho vai além de "fotos bonitas": entregamos uma experiência afetiva, conduzida com acolhimento e um olhar atento aos detalhes, ao comportamento e ao conforto do animal.

Cada ensaio é planejado de forma personalizada, para que o resultado traduza verdade, conexão e história.

Objetivo da função

Ser a pessoa responsável por
converter leads em sessões agendadas
, com atendimento rápido, consultivo e com follow-up consistente, fazendo prospecção ativa com a base de clientes recorrentes.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Atender leads via
    WhatsApp/Instagram/Telefone
    com rapidez e clareza.
  • Fazer
    qualificação
    (perfil do tutor, tipo de pet, objetivo, disponibilidade, urgência).
  • Apresentar
    pacotes/condições
    e conduzir a negociação até o fechamento.
  • Agendar sessões e coordenar
    agenda
    com a equipe desde o início até a entrega final das fotos.
  • Registrar tudo em
    CRM/planilha
    (etapa do lead, motivo de perda, status do pagamento).
  • Fazer
    follow-up
    diário dos leads abertos.
  • Garantir o básico do pós-venda: confirmação de sessão, checklist do cliente, alinhamento de expectativas.
  • Sinalizar gargalos para o marketing (objeções recorrentes, etapas que travam conversão).

Indicadores de sucesso (KPIs)

  • Tempo de primeira resposta:
    meta de 5 minutos em horário comercial.
  • Taxa de conversão Lead → Agendamento/Fechamento:
    meta de 15%
  • Follow-up diário:
    90% de leads sem ficar "parado".
  • Organização do funil:
    100% dos leads com etapa definida e motivo de perda registrado.

Requisitos (obrigatórios)

  • Experiência com
    atendimento comercial
    (WhatsApp/DM) e
    fechamento
    .
  • Escrita objetiva e profissional (sem enrolação, sem "texto pronto genérico").
  • Organização para trabalhar com
    funil, agenda e rotina de follow-up
    .
  • Conforto com metas e remuneração variável.
  • Equipamento e internet para trabalho (nos dias remotos).

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Experiência com negócios de
    serviço/agenda
    (estética, saúde, fotografia, eventos).
  • Experiência com CRM (Canva, Notion, Trello, etc.).

Remuneração (PJ)

  • Fixo mensal:
    R$ 1.800,00
  • Comissão por meta de faturamento

Processo seletivo

  1. Triagem pelo LinkedIn
  2. Conversa rápida (15–20 min)
  3. Teste prático simples (organização de funil + simulação de atendimento)
  4. Entrevista final com sócios

Como se candidatar

Enviar (currículo/LinkedIn) + uma mensagem curta respondendo:

  • Qual sua experiência com atendimento e vendas por WhatsApp?
  • Qual resultado/indicador você já bateu em função comercial?

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Verndale is a digital experience agency dedicated to driving growth by helping businesses create meaningful human connections in an increasingly digital world. With offices in Boston, Montreal, Los Angeles, Quito, and hubs across the Americas, we partner with marketing and technology leaders to deliver personalized web, mobile, and ecommerce solutions that elevate customer experiences.
At Verndale, we thrive on collaboration and innovation, offering a full range of services that span strategy, design, development, personalization, SEO, analytics, and digital advertising. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, striving to create a climate of respect essential for both individual and company success.
If you're ready to be part of a passionate team dedicated to making an impact and driving growth, we invite you to explore a career at Verndale.
About The Role
We are looking for a Senior Project Manager with a passion for working hand-in-hand with our clients to deliver world-class interactive experiences. Our work includes experience design, digital marketing campaigns, eCommerce and CMS implementations, CRM programs and content development. As a Senior Project Manager, you will help develop and execute the plans that allow our teams to create great work and deliver tremendous value. To succeed in this role, you will need to be a natural leader, an advocate for your team and your clients, have a passion for technology and possess strong project management and communication skills.
Responsibilities
Solve problems. Recognize the nature of each problem and ensure the right people are involved to help solve it. Be an active contributor to that solution, not just a communication facilitator.
Manage ongoing work, budgets, and schedules for a portfolio of client accounts.
Maintain an understanding of Verndale's capabilities and be able to match those capabilities up with client needs. Recognize gaps in capabilities and work with management to devise solutions to fill those gaps.
Work with clients and internal teams to ensure that all work is in line with clients' short- and long-term strategic goals.
Deliver regular status reports to clients
Coordinate internal teams to ensure the right people are on the right projects at the right time.
Mentor other Project Coordinators and Project Managers.
Define and enhance project and business processes, ensure teams are following appropriate processes. Know why process is important but don't be afraid to deviate from it when the situation warrants it. Draw on your agency background and creativity to suggest and implement process enhancements.
Facilitate communication and alignment between Verndale's team, client teams, and third parties as needed. Break down barriers that impede progress.
Create, manage, and communicate project/initiative schedules to all involved parties and stakeholders
Assist account team with knowledge of clients and project needs to aid revenue growth within the account
Keep up to date on a broad spectrum of technologies, recognizing when new technologies or updates offer new opportunities for clients.
Qualifications
5–7+ years managing digital/technology projects in an agency or consulting environment.
Proven experience leading full lifecycle web or platform implementations (e.g., Sitecore, Content stack, Webflow, Optimizely).
Strong project financial management: forecasting, burn tracking, managing to budget, and driving profitable delivery.
Demonstrated success with scope, risk, and change management in complex, multi-stakeholder engagements.
Excellent client-facing communication and expectation management (written and verbal).
Strong cross-functional collaboration with strategy, UX, engineering, QA, and DevOps teams.
Experience managing multi-vendor or offshore/nearshore teams.
Solid command of Jira and common PM tools (Confluence, MS Project/Smartsheet, etc.).
Comfortable working in hybrid Agile / waterfall delivery model
Nice to Have
Background with digital commerce, customer portals, or large content-driven sites.
Familiarity with GA4, GTM, and analytics-driven optimization initiatives.
Formal PM credentials (e.g., PMP, CSM, SAFe, or equivalent).
Experience in statement of work (SOW) creation and upsell/expansion discussions with clients.
Ten Great Reasons to Work at Verndale
We are a rapidly growing company that is just as scrappy and entrepreneurial today as when we were founded in 1998.
We are relentlessly curious and enthusiastically solve our clients' complex business problems through technology, data, and design.
We foster a culture that enables every person in the organization to do the best work of their career.
We offer regular training and professional development to move careers forward.
Client and employee satisfaction are our two most important business metrics.
We celebrate and champion diversity, equity, and inclusion.
We offer generous paid company holidays, vacation, and paid sick time to every employee starting on day one.
We offer top-of-the-line Health Insurance, plus monthly perks customized to meet individual employees' needs.
We support a healthy work/life balance.
We are fully remote enabled and embrace the evolving definition of the workplace

title: Procurement Assistant
description:
This job is with United Nations, an inclusive employer and a member of myGwork – the largest global platform for the LGBTQ+ business community. Please do not contact the recruiter directly.
Result of ServiceThe Procurement Assistant reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under these Terms of Reference, supporting the administrative and procurement implementation of projects and initiatives. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the Operational Team of UN-Habitat in Rio de Janeiro and HQs.
Work LocationRio de Janeiro, RJ, Brazil
Expected durationSix (6) months, with possibility of renewal
Duties and ResponsibilitiesBackground The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. To meet with greater demand for projects' implementation, the office of Rio de Janeiro is looking for a Procurement Assistant that will be focusing on Brazil initiatives. The professional will be asked to assist the office team by contributing to the administrative and procurement of projects and initiatives. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Procurement Assistant reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Procurement Assistant will support the implementation of the projects in Brazil, with the following responsibilities: a. Support the administrative implementation of projects and initiatives, ensuring compliance with organizational policies and procedures. b. Support procurement processes for goods, services, and works, ensuring full compliance with organizational procurement rules, policies, and ethical standards. c. Plan, manage, and monitor procurement activities in line with approved project workplans, budgets, and timelines under supervision. d. Support the preparation of procurement documentation, including solicitation documents, evaluations, contracts, and purchase orders. e. Support procurement planning with programme, finance, and operations teams to ensure timely delivery and budget alignment. f. Help vendor sourcing, market research, and supplier evaluations to ensure value for money, transparency, and fairness. g. Monitor contract implementation, including deliverables, timelines, amendments, and closure, in coordination with relevant units. h. Maintain accurate and complete procurement records and ensure proper filing in corporate systems. i. Provide guidance and technical support to programme teams on procurement procedures and requirements. j. Identify procurement risks and propose mitigation measures to strengthen compliance and efficiency. k. Contribute to continuous improvement of procurement processes, tools, and templates. l. Assist in budget planning, monitoring, and revisions, including tracking expenditures against approved budgets, specially in relation to procurement. m. Support and follow up on financial transactions, such as payments, advances, reimbursements, and vendor contracts. n. Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial and administrative records for projects and operations. o. Organize and archive all documents and information relevant to project administration. p. Support the team through audits and other administrative and financial compliance checks. q. Monitor financial reporting timelines and contribute to the preparation of financial reports for internal and external stakeholders. r. Support audits and financial reviews by ensuring availability and organization of required documentation. s. Be responsible of for inventory and warehouse management. t. Write official letters in Portuguese. u. Be responsible for keeping information organized and accessible. v. Participate in missions as requested. w. Carry out other activities requested by the Head of Office and/or Program Officer within the framework of this consultancy, without prejudice to fulfilling their responsibilities. m. Prepare reports to partners, internal reports, etc. at various stages of the projects. n. Perform other duties which may be requested by the supervisor. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Procurement Assistant shall support the Program Officers in the proper planning and management of programmes' implementation related to the office's project portfolio, according to the stated responsibilities. The consultant shall be paid a monthly allowance, upon presentation and approval by the Head of Brazil Office of monthly activities' report.
Qualifications/special skillsEducation
Bachelor's degree in International Relations, Public Administration, Administration, Economics, or related fields is required, or additional three (3) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement. Work experience
A minimum of three (3) years of experience in program' implementation and projects in public administration or international organizations, administrative and financial issues, and/or related areas is required.
Demonstrated experience in administrative and finance is required.
Work experience within the United Nations System is desirable.
International experience is desirable, particularly in the field of international cooperation for development, urban development, and project management. Skills
Good computer skills in Office Package (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook) are required.
Mastery of technological tools and use of software and online platforms is required.
Good knowledge of project management methodologies is desirable. Competencies
Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation; approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision; proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively; listen to others, interpret messages correctly and respond appropriately; show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed; solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management and consensus facilitation skills; ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity; sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability; willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to project development.
The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.
Languages
English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required. Working knowledge of English and/or Spanish is desirable.
Additional InformationTravel details: The consultant must be available to travel to the places related to the activities in the country, if requested by the Head of Brazil Office. Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines.
