This position offers the opportunity to teach bright, motivated students from around the world while maintaining flexibility in your schedule. You'll play a key role in delivering high-quality, personalized learning experiences as we continue to expand our reach globally

Overview

The Dean is a cornerstone of Crimson Global Academy, driving student and staff success through strategic oversight of academic programs and meaningful stakeholder collaboration. Working collaboratively with the Deputy Principal, other deans, principals, and the Head of School, you will support the effective operation and continuous improvement of school programs while ensuring the vision and integrity of the US Diploma Program remains central as it continues to serve students globally. This Dean will support curriculum alignment, maintenance, and development aligned with CGA initiatives, while providing essential support to teachers and students across all learning modes.

This role serves as a key operational partner to the Deputy Principal, providing direct support for group class instruction, student services, and day-to-day academic operations. The Dean helps ensure the Deputy Principal can focus on strategic initiatives and complex problem-solving by managing core responsibilities, including homeroom programs, student check-ins, faculty communication, and curriculum documentation.

The ideal candidate combines operational excellence with forward-thinking innovation – someone who understands the nuances of online education while possessing the vision to help shape CGA as an educational institution of the future. Your ability to communicate effectively across time zones, solve complex problems, maintain a global perspective, collaborate across departments, and execute with precision will be essential to your success.

Key Responsibilities

1. Student Success & Community Building

  • Support the Deputy Principal in ensuring comprehensive student services and engagement across all learning modes
  • Attend and support student processes and school-wide assemblies
  • Support and promote student participation in extracurricular activities
  • Support and mentor student leaders in their roles and initiatives, coordinating with the Deputy Principal on NHS and club activities
  • Attend and contribute to ceremonies that celebrate student achievements and student recognition programs
  • Support implementation of best practices in online high school community engagement
  • Proactively monitor student attendance and academic performance, implementing intervention strategies when necessary and escalating complex cases to the Deputy Principal
  • Conduct regular student check‑ins to identify challenges and provide timely support, serving as a first point of contact before escalation
  • Lead student homeroom programs across all sections to ensure consistent quality
  • Support students across all three learning modes: CGA Group, Da Vinci, and Flex Courses
  • Assist the Deputy Principal with student wellbeing programs and family communications

2. Faculty Development & Curriculum Support

  • Collaborate with the Deputy Principal, principals, other deans, and school leadership on policy development, implementation, and review
  • Support group class teachers in delivering high‑quality instruction across all courses, assisting the Deputy Principal with teacher observations and feedback
  • Lead curriculum alignment, maintenance, and creation initiatives to ensure consistency with CGA standards and educational goals, supporting the Deputy Principal's oversight of academic programs
  • Develop and execute a comprehensive curriculum review cycle to continuously enhance educational offerings
  • Create curriculum mapping documentation to ensure vertical and horizontal alignment across grade levels and subjects, supporting the Deputy Principal's curriculum oversight responsibilities
  • Establish and maintain curriculum standards that reflect both US diploma requirements and global best practices
  • Design and implement assessment strategies that align with curriculum objectives and measure student achievement effectively
  • Identify and secure US pathway‑specific resources to enhance curriculum delivery
  • Work closely with department heads and group class teachers to ensure course alignment, promote best practices in online teaching, and maintain consistent staff communication
  • Facilitate professional development opportunities for teachers across all learning modes, supporting the Deputy Principal's staff development initiatives
  • Participate in monthly staff briefings and contribute to teacher training focused on online pedagogy
  • Provide day‑to‑day support for group class instructors, allowing the Deputy Principal to focus on strategic instructional leadership

3. Operational Excellence & Administrative Support

  • Partner with the Deputy Principal and leadership team on policy development, implementation, and periodic review
  • Support the Deputy Principal with calendar management and timetabling coordination, ensuring timely communication of important dates to all stakeholders
  • Assist with schedule changes and resolve minor conflicts, escalating complex issues to the Deputy Principal
  • Coordinate effectively across multiple time zones to support CGA's global student body
  • Support in maintaining organized student records and documentation in the student information system, ensuring data accuracy and clarity
  • Monitor and help approve students through the Enrollment Improvement Channel, working collaboratively with Admissions Officers and the Deputy Principal
  • Apply strong knowledge of the US diploma system and transfer credit policy to support student academic planning and course placement decisions
  • Review and evaluate transfer credits in accordance with school policy, escalating complex cases to the Deputy Principal as needed
  • Assist with communications to students, parents, and staff regarding academic programs, policies, and diploma requirements
  • Support AP course coordination and College Board requirements as needed
  • Take on additional responsibilities as reasonably requested by Crimson Global Academy
  • Maintain and update staff and student‑facing documentation to ensure accuracy and relevance
  • Support coordination and consistency across CGA Group, Da Vinci, and Flex Courses learning modes
  • Assist the Deputy Principal with admissions support activities, including academic planning discussions and information sessions
  • Help manage day‑to‑day operational tasks, enabling the Deputy Principal to focus on strategic problem‑solving and complex challenges

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of professional experience in education, with demonstrated success in student and curriculum support
  • Strong understanding of the US diploma system, graduation requirements, and transcript management
  • Knowledge of transfer credit evaluation and policy application
  • Proven experience in remote work environments and ability to work effectively across multiple time zones
  • Demonstrated skill in education program development and execution
  • Experience supporting group class instruction and teacher development
  • Understanding of differentiated instruction and learning accommodations
  • Experience with student information systems and maintaining accurate academic records
  • Counseling experience or qualification (preferred)
  • Exceptional attention to detail with strong task prioritization abilities
  • Adaptable mindset with capacity to pivot quickly in response to changing needs
  • Self‑directed work style with ability to execute independently while maintaining alignment with institutional goals
  • Strong collaborative skills and ability to work effectively with multiple stakeholders across leadership levels, particularly in supporting the Deputy Principal's strategic initiatives
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills to support operational efficiency
  • Passion for educational innovation and willingness to initiate self‑driven projects that advance the school's mission

About Crimson Global Academy

Crimson Global Academy is a premier online high school delivering world‑class education through innovative digital platforms. Our US Diploma Program provides students around the world with a rigorous academic experience that prepares them for success at top universities globally, offered through three distinct learning modes: CGA Group, Da Vinci, and Flex Courses.

title: Senior Software Engineer - MAAS
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our Metal As A Service hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get it there. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go, and we are looking for experienced software engineers who understand performance at scale, networking, storage and usability.

Applicants should be passionate about the future of Ubuntu and be able to show technical leadership with a globally distributed team of engineers who share that passion. This position requires international travel several times a year.

This role entails

  • Develop MAAS core components and features to make MAAS the #1 bare metal cloud system.
  • Shape the architecture of MAAS to make it simpler, faster and easier to use.
  • Collaborate with other teams to ensure MAAS works well with other tools and is released on time.
  • Contribute your improvements to our continuous integration environment, tests and practices, to maintain fast feedback and good test coverage.
  • Contribute to documentation of current and existing features, making it world‑class resource for Data Centre operators and users.
  • Provide technical communication and collaboration with other teams where appropriate.
  • Take personal ownership of problems and drive them to solutions.
  • Travel internationally a few times a year to meet and collaborate with you and other teams.

What we are looking for in you

  • Passionate about open source software, Linux, and Data Centre automation
  • Solid track record of professional software development experience in Python, Go for back‑end roles, or TypeScript, React for front‑end roles.
  • Capacity to learn quickly about new systems and techniques
  • Excellent logic, problem solving, and troubleshooting skills
  • Strong English language communication skills - both written and verbal
  • Experience with Linux server technologies, including but not limited to Virtualization (KVM), Containers (LXC), etc.
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • Knowledge of network technologies, including PXE, DHCP, TFTP, DNS, NTP
  • Some experience with Baseboard Management Controllers and Protocols (Redfish, IPMI, AMT and others)
  • Strong experience with networking, storage technologies and Cloud hosting and infrastructure.
  • Ideally, experience of large‑scale physical server provisioning and automation, including rapid deployment, configuration, management and service orchestration.
  • Familiarity with some of the open source development tools and methodologies used in creation of several Ubuntu projects (MAAS, Juju, Ubuntu Server, LXD, Ubuntu Core), such as Launchpad, Debian packaging tools (APT, dpkg) and snapcraft.
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university.
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance‑driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

This is an exciting opportunity for an exceptional software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, and Web Services at scale. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, a growing international software company.

Canonical's Store team develops and operates a large system of backend services that power the Snap Store and Charmhub.io marketplaces. Our services are built primarily in Python, with a bit of Golang.

We have some exciting challenges ahead including continuing to scale our production architecture, significantly expanding the range of software we can deliver through the system powering our marketplaces, and enhancing our offering for the booming world of IoT and for large Enterprise solutions.

If you have a passion for clean APIs, have a bias towards shipping, and believe that automated tests are the key to higher velocity and reliability, you\'ll fit right in.

What you\'ll do

  • Collaborate remotely with a globally distributed team.
  • Write clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Python (and optionally Golang).
  • Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale.
  • Review code and technical designs produced by other engineers.
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions.
  • Work remotely with global travel for 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events.

Who you are

  • You have demonstrated professional proficiency in developing public-facing APIs and web applications using Python.
  • You have a broad technology base but favour backend code and infrastructure.
  • You know your way around relational and non-relational databases and can effectively design data models that perform well, and tune queries to access them.
  • You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform.
  • You have demonstrated strong academic performance in Computer Science, STEM or a similar degree.
  • You love technology and working with a diverse set of talented people.
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable.
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated.

About Canonical

Canonical is a growing, international software company that works with the open-source community to deliver Ubuntu -- the world\'s #1 cloud operating system. Our mission is to realise the potential of free software in the lives of individuals and organisations. Our services are helping businesses worldwide to reduce costs, improve efficiency and enhance security with Ubuntu. Canonical is a unique tech company - global, remote-first, open source, with 700 professionals across 50 countries - we want to be the world\'s best, not biggest, global software company. With almost every team remote by default, Canonical sets the pace on the 21st-century digital workplace.

What Canonical offers:

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

About TestBox

TestBox was founded with a bold mission : to fundamentally transform how software is bought and sold. We're building an innovative platform that empowers buyers with transparent, interactive software experiences, while equipping sellers with powerful tools to deliver exceptional buying and onboarding journeys. Our core technologies—synthetic data, intelligent orchestration, and our unique product graph—help teams achieve faster implementations, clearer insights, and increase trust with their customers.

As a Solutions Architect at TestBox, you'll be at the heart of our customer experience—designing, building, and delivering high-impact demo and POC environments that drive sales success for our customers.

You’ll lead technical delivery, participate in agile rituals like standups and retros, and act as a trusted consultant to help customers design stories that resonate. You’ll also be expected to innovate and move fast—this isn't a role for someone looking to just “follow the playbook.”

To succeed here, you’ll need to be curious, flexible, and scrappy. You’ll work cross-functionally with engineering, product, and go-to-market teams, and you’ll use AI tools (including our own) daily to boost your productivity, generate data, and solve complex problems creatively.

Project Ownership & Delivery

  • Continuously explore ways to innovate and disrupt traditional workflows using AI—TestBox is built on this mindset.

Documentation & Ticket Writing

  • Create detailed technical tickets and documentation to support repeatable environment setup and engineering handoffs.
  • Maintain internal knowledge resources for templates, industry scenarios, and technical edge cases.

Who You Are

  • You're fluent in english.

  • You think like a builder, act like an owner, and communicate like a product manager.
  • You thrive in startups : ambiguity excites you, pivots don't scare you, and you prioritize speed over perfection.
  • You believe AI is a power tool , not a novelty—and you're already using it to make your work better and faster.
  • You're comfortable translating between customer needs and technical systems, and enjoy being at the intersection of product, engineering, and sales.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with APIs, automation logic, and data formats like CSV and JSON.
  • Experience working in agile environments (standups, retros, ticket grooming, etc.).

  • Bonus : Familiarity with synthetic data or interactive storytelling in demos. Completion of AI‑focused courses, certifications, or hands‑on projects.

description:
The Canonical Security Operations team is hiring for a Senior or Staff engineer. The Security Operations team is responsible for designing, building, and operating a world‑class Security Operations Center, and the successful candidate will provide leadership, mentorship, expertise, and outstanding individual contributions towards those ends.

This role involves aspects of:

  • Traditional SOC duties - security monitoring, threat hunting, and response.
  • Security engineering - assessing and protecting Canonical platforms and products.
  • Software engineering - building custom tools and platforms.
  • Site reliability engineering - deploying, maintaining, and automating security tools.

We are looking for individuals with engineering and security experience, as well as a history of remarkable achievement. Senior security operations personnel with engineering experience and senior developers with security experience are equally well‑suited to this role.

Beyond securing Canonical's digital estate, this position represents a unique opportunity to contribute to the open source ecosystem. Team members may present at industry conferences, share threat intelligence with the wider community, or publish open‑source security software.

Junior positions are also available for less‑experienced individuals with a compelling academic or professional background.

In this role, you will:

  • Provide operational and engineering leadership.
  • Implement and evolve Canonical's Security Operations Center.
  • Design and develop security software and platforms.
  • Monitor for, identify, respond to, and remediate security incidents.
  • Assess and improve Canonical's security controls.
  • Mentor early‑career Security Operations engineers.
  • Plan and deliver work within Canonical's agile engineering framework.
  • Contribute to open source security.
  • Publish blog posts, whitepapers and conference presentations.

We are looking for:

  • An exceptional academic track record.
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path.
  • 10+ years of relevant professional experience.
  • Professional cybersecurity experience, preferably working or leading a Security Operations Center.
  • Professional engineering experience.
  • An eagerness to contribute to open source security.
  • Proficiency in common scripting languages, such as Python and Bash.
  • Knowledge of Git, GitOps, Infrastructure‑as‑Code, and common orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes).

Though optional, we value:

  • Familiarity with security frameworks such as the NIST CSF, CIS CSC, and ISO 27001.
  • Knowledge of security architecture and market‑leading security tools.
  • Experience in a security operations team or a security operations center.
  • Experience in offensive or defensive security teams with hands‑on ability.
  • Experience with advanced persistent threats.
  • Proficiency in additional programming languages, such as Golang.

What we offer you:

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance‑driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote‑first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Responsible for the successful implementation of the Media Operations at all stadiums in Brazil for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.

Media Operations is a very important function in the organisation, as this area is providing the services and conditions for all media to report about the competition to millions of viewers, listeners and readers around the world.

Reporting organisationally to the Head of Media Operations & Services, the Senior Media Operations Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team, and work in close collaboration with Venue Management, Team Services, Competition Management, Media Partnerships, Host Broadcast Operations, Host City Rights Management and other key individuals responsible for planning, delivering and managing Media operations for the more than 2000 national and international media expected to attend the FIFA Women’s World Cup. Success with this project will contribute favourably to the positive outcome of the Women’s Football Strategy .

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Plan and deliver consistent media-dedicated spaces and flows, in all of competition venues in collaboration with other key functional areas.
  • Define strategic implementation of Media Operations & Services in collaboration with the Services manager in each host city based on unique availability of resources.
  • Support the planning and implementation of all corporate media activities for the FIFA Women’s World Cup.
  • Ensure media areas at the competition venues are set up to the highest possible industry standards and are ready to be operational within the agreed timeframe ahead of the start of the tournament.
  • Work in close collaboration with the Senior Media Services Manager to define space requirements for International News Agency representatives at competition venues.
  • Event-time coordination and management of the Venue Media Managers team in the stadiums. Set up regular meetings and workshops with the Venue Media Managers of the stadiums.
  • Plan and train the media volunteers together with the venue managers.
  • Support engagement with local and international media to define requirements and ensure the delivery of operations is set to the highest standards.
  • Implementation of the Camera Loan & repair facilities and any new service.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent
  • Higher education qualification in media or sports event management
  • 5+ years’ experience in the sports industry, with an emphasis on media and broadcast operations
  • 5-7 years’ experience in sports project management, preferably in football
  • Fluent in English, Portuguese, Spanish and/or French proficiency is a plus
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

The Dean is a cornerstone of Crimson Global Academy, driving student and staff success through strategic oversight of academic programmes and meaningful stakeholder collaboration. Working collaboratively with the Deputy Principal, other deans, principals, and the Head of School, you will support the effective operation and continuous improvement of school programmes while ensuring the vision and integrity of the US Diploma Programme remains central as it continues to serve students worldwide. This Dean will support curriculum alignment, maintenance and development aligned with CGA initiatives, while providing essential support to teachers and students across all learning modes.

This role serves as a key operational partner to the Deputy Principal, providing direct support for group class instruction, student services and day‑to‑day academic operations. The Dean helps ensure the Deputy Principal can focus on strategic initiatives and complex problem‑solving by managing core responsibilities, including homeroom programmes, student check‑ins, faculty communication and curriculum documentation.

The ideal candidate combines operational excellence with forward‑thinking innovation – someone who understands the nuances of online education while possessing the vision to help shape CGA as an educational institution of the future. Your ability to communicate effectively across time zones, solve complex problems, maintain a global perspective, collaborate across departments and execute with precision will be essential to your success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Student Success & Community Building
    • Support the Deputy Principal in ensuring comprehensive student services and engagement across all learning modes
    • Attend and support student processes and school‑wide assemblies
    • Support and promote student participation in extracurricular activities
    • Support and mentor student leaders, coordinating with the Deputy Principal on NHS and club activities
    • Attend and contribute to ceremonies that celebrate student achievements and recognition programmes
    • Support implementation of best practices in online high‑school community engagement
    • Proactively monitor student attendance and academic performance, implementing intervention strategies when necessary and escalating complex cases to the Deputy Principal
    • Conduct regular student check‑ins to identify challenges and provide timely support, serving as a first point of contact before escalation
    • Lead student homeroom programmes across all sections to ensure consistent quality
    • Support students across all three learning modes: CGA Group, Da Vinci and Flex Courses
    • Assist with student wellbeing programmes and family communications
  • Faculty Development & Curriculum Support
    • Collaborate with the Deputy Principal, principals, other deans and school leadership on policy development, implementation and review
    • Support group class teachers in delivering high‑quality instruction across all courses, assisting with teacher observations and feedback
    • Lead curriculum alignment, maintenance and creation initiatives to ensure consistency with CGA standards and educational goals
    • Develop and execute a comprehensive curriculum review cycle to continuously enhance educational offerings
    • Create curriculum‑mapping documentation for vertical and horizontal alignment across grade levels and subjects
    • Establish and maintain curriculum standards reflecting US diploma requirements and global best practices
    • Design and implement assessment strategies aligned with curriculum objectives and measuring student achievement effectively
    • Identify and secure US pathway‑specific resources to enhance curriculum delivery
    • Work closely with department heads and group class teachers to ensure course alignment, promote best practices in online teaching and maintain consistent staff communication
    • Facilitate professional development opportunities for teachers across all learning modes
    • Participate in monthly staff briefings and contribute to teacher training focused on online pedagogy
  • Operational Excellence & Administrative Support
    • Partner with the Deputy Principal and leadership team on policy development, implementation and periodic review
    • Support the Deputy Principal with calendar management and timetabling coordination, ensuring timely communication of important dates
    • Assist with schedule changes and resolve minor conflicts, escalating complex issues to the Deputy Principal
    • Coordinate across multiple time zones to support CGA’s global student body
    • Maintain organised student records and documentation in the student information system, ensuring data accuracy and clarity
    • Monitor and help approve students through the Enrollment Improvement Channel, collaborating with Admissions Officers and the Deputy Principal
    • Apply knowledge of the US diploma system and transfer‑credit policy to support student academic planning and course‑placement decisions
    • Review and evaluate transfer credits in accordance with school policy, escalating complex cases to the Deputy Principal as needed
    • Communicate with students, parents and staff regarding academic programmes, policies and diploma requirements
    • Support AP course coordination and College Board requirements as needed
    • Take on additional responsibilities as reasonably requested by Crimson Global Academy
    • Maintain and update staff and student‑facing documentation to ensure accuracy and relevance
    • Support coordination and consistency across CGA Group, Da Vinci and Flex Courses learning modes
    • Assist with admissions support activities, including academic planning discussions and information sessions

  • Strong understanding of the US diploma system, graduation requirements and transcript management
  • Knowledge of transfer‑credit evaluation and policy application
  • Proven experience in remote work environments and ability to work effectively across multiple time zones
  • Demonstrated skill in educational programme development and execution

description:
Overview

Galp has been part of society for generations, and as energy changes, we adapt too. Here you will have the opportunity to grow, with the resources you need to develop at your own pace, in your own way. Together we can continue to contribute to the communities where we live and work. About your future Team

You\'ll be joining Reservoir Engineering Team, sharing their mission to deliver decision-ready, high-quality reservoir engineering analyses that directly influence asset development, reserves maturation, and production optimization, while acting as a technical reference within the RE team and across upstream disciplines.

How will your day-to-day look like

  • Compressively and independently manage reservoir engineering discipline scopes across multiple assets, with business focus;
  • Own and deliver reservoir engineering studies for assigned assets across the asset life cycle;

What makes you unique

  • Advanced dynamic simulation capability (history matching and forecasting) using Eclipse and Intersect;
  • Proven experience influencing well testing, well completion, development concepts, well phasing, and production strategies;
  • Reservoir engineering studies execution, including integration of well test data into forecasts and simulations;
  • Reserves and Resources classification expertise;
  • Uncertainty framing and scenario-based decision support;
  • Ability to translate complex technical work into clear business implications;
  • Strong cross-disciplinary integration (geology, petrophysics, production, facilities);
  • Structured problem solving and analytical rigour;
  • Proactive, independent and integrative mindset;

Benefits

  • An energy company integrated in the energy sector where you can make a difference;

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

title: Head of Brand, Marketing and Promotion
description:
Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Position Overview

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • Responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament.
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones.
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property, including but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament.
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in marketing, or a marketing related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in a relevant leadership position.
  • Proven experience delivering major brand & marketing plans.
  • Experience in the sports and/or entertainment industry is a major plus.
  • Experience working in a global or international environment.
  • Proven track record in managing a team in a matrix or similar structure.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills and the ability to manage up, down and sideways.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Profound knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture.
  • Ability to work to deadlines and stress resilient.
  • Financial and budget management.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Additional Information

  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Contract
  • Job function: Marketing and Sales

Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at FIFA Women’s World Cup™ by 2x.

description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world. Today, we are part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide. No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Associate director - Flights Marketing

Get to Know ourTeam:

The Performance Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. This department is highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of Agoda customers through measurable marketing programs and channels. The team is a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. The marketing leadership at Agoda have deep experience in data science, product, strategy, and other marketing fields and have built an organization that thrives on data, creative ideas, and technology. The Performance Marketing Team also fosters a great learning environment. You will be able to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a variety of backgrounds from all over the world.

In this role, you’ll getto:

  • Co-own the flights PnL with Product counterparts
  • Define the overall Marketing Strategy for Flights Vertical
  • Execute the strategy: spearhead the development, execution, and optimization for growing Agoda’s Flights business on different channels (e.g., CRM, Paid Peformance marketing, pricing)
  • Guide, coach and manage a team who
  • Conduct end-to-end analysis of large, complex datasets related to channel performance, user behavior, and market trends, translating raw data into actionable insights
  • Develop hypotheses, design experiments (e.g., A/B tests), and build structured analyses to rigorously evaluate campaign effectiveness and drive data-driven decisions for channel growth
  • Partner closely with various business functions, especially Marketing Accommodation, Flights product and flights supply, to identify opportunities, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns in complex data sets using different techniques and tools such as SQL or Tableau to drive meaningful initiatives
  • Monitor and report on the effectiveness of business initiatives, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement.
  • Communicate complex findings, performance updates, and strategic recommendations clearly and concisely to key stakeholders, including senior management
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of analysts and managers; participate in hiring and onboarding new team members.

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • Extensive Experience: 10+ years in Data Analyst position or otherwise in projects involving big data — preferably in the tech, e-commerce, or digital marketing industry. Experience in articulating strategic issues and negotiating with C-level executives – experience in leading strategy consulting projects
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science/Statistics/Math or Engineering or Economics and Finance
  • Data-Driven Approach: Strong analytical skills with the ability to analyze data, translate data into actionable insights, and generate impactful recommendations. You really need to love data for this role!
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL
  • Strong Communication Skills: Exceptional writing and verbal communication abilities, with proficiency in creating impactful and visually appealing presentations.
  • Stakeholder management: Ability to effectively communicate, influence and persuade with different levels of stakeholders (especially Senior Management) with proven strong commercial acumen
  • People management experience: including hiring, coaching, and developing team members
  • Entrepreneurial mindset: A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset with a strong sense of ownership and a get-thing-done attitude.

It’s great if you have:

  • Experience in digital or social media marketing
  • Experience in the online travel or e-commerce industry
  • Experience in flights industry
  • Experience in hypothesis testing frameworks, statistical analysis, and using Python/R for data manipulation and analysis.

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Chief of Staff

The Chief of Staff serves as the Dean’s senior strategic advisor and operational partner, providing executive-level leadership support, institutional coordination, and oversight of school-wide strategic initiatives. This role is responsible for translating the Dean’s vision into actionable priorities, ensuring alignment across academic, administrative, and operational functions, and supporting decision‑making at the highest level of the School.

This position is designed as a future‑state leadership role focused on strategy, governance, and executive coordination. It does not manage day‑to‑day program execution, event planning, or operational delivery functions, which are carried out within academic and administrative units.

The Chief of Staff reports directly to the Dean of the School of Communications.

Supervisory Authority

The Chief of Staff may provide functional and strategic oversight of administrative staff or project teams as assigned by the Dean. Supervisory authority, when delegated, is focused on initiative coordination, performance alignment, and accountability, rather than day‑to‑day task supervision. This role does not supervise academic programs.

Nature and Scope

The Chief of Staff operates at the executive level within the School of Communications and supports the Dean through strategic coordination, leadership advising, and institutional alignment. The role requires independent judgment, discretion, and a high level of professional integrity. The scope of the position is strategic and advisory, rather than programmatic or operational.

Key Responsibilities

Executive Strategy & Leadership Support

  • Serve as the Dean’s principal strategic advisor on institutional priorities, organizational effectiveness, and operational planning.
  • Support the development, implementation, and monitoring of school‑wide strategic initiatives and long‑range goals.
  • Prepare executive‑level briefings, analyses, and recommendations to support informed decision‑making.

Institutional Coordination & Governance

  • Coordinate cross‑functional efforts among academic leadership, administrative units, and external stakeholders to ensure alignment with the School’s mission and objectives.
  • Represent the Dean, as appropriate, in senior‑level meetings, working groups, and institutional forums.
  • Monitor progress on key initiatives and elevate risks, dependencies, and decision points to the Dean.

Operational Oversight (Strategic Level)

  • Provide high‑level oversight of administrative and operational workflows to ensure efficiency, accountability, and alignment with institutional standards.
  • Partner with senior administrators to identify opportunities for process improvement and organizational alignment.
  • Support clarity in leadership roles, responsibilities, and decision‑making authority.

Communications & Special Projects

  • Lead or support high‑priority initiatives and special projects at the direction of the Dean.
  • Draft, review, and coordinate executive communications, reports, and institutional correspondence.
  • Ensure consistency and clarity in messaging across leadership initiatives.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic leadership and sound judgment
  • Executive‑level written and verbal communication
  • Organizational effectiveness and process improvement
  • Stakeholder engagement and relationship management
  • Analytical thinking and problem‑solving
  • Project and initiative oversight
  • Professional discretion and integrity

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred or Minimum 5 years of progressively responsible and relevant work experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in executive‑level administration, strategic planning, or institutional leadership.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in complex, fast‑paced academic environments.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$95,000-$105,000

A L'Oréal está presente em mais de 150 países em cinco continentes. Há 30 anos, a Provider IT apoia grandes empresas em sua evolução digital, com estratégia, inovação e, acima de tudo, foco em pessoas. Nossa trajetória é marcada por conexões duradouras com clientes, parceiros e colaboradores que crescem com a gente e ajudam a construir um ambiente acolhedor, colaborativo e sustentável. Agora, vivemos uma nova fase: mais estruturada, intencional e com um posicionamento claro rumo ao futuro. A Inteligência Artificial, já presente nas nossas entregas, passa a fazer parte da nossa cultura e forma de pensar. Com uma mentalidade AI First, buscamos soluções que ampliem o potencial humano, aumentem a eficiência e gerem impacto real.

Venha fazer parte de um time que impulsiona a próxima geração de soluções tecnológicas!

Analista de Dados Sênior

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Dados Sênior para atuar no desenvolvimento de análises estratégicas e operacionais, apoiando as áreas de engenharia, operações, manutenção, financeiro e gestão de ativos. Este(a) profissional será responsável por transformar dados em insights que contribuam para a otimização da produção, eficiência operacional e melhoria contínua dos processos. A posição exige forte capacidade analítica, visão sistêmica do negócio e habilidade para interagir com equipes multidisciplinares.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Coletar, consolidar e analisar dados operacionais, financeiros e corporativos relacionados aos ativos de óleo e gás

  • Documentar processos, indicadores e soluções analíticas
  • Atuar como referência técnica em análise de dados dentro da organização

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas
  • Experiência comprovada como Analista de Dados, preferencialmente em nível sênior
  • Domínio avançado de SQL
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados, como Power BI, Tableau ou similares
  • Experiência com Python
  • Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios gerenciais
  • Conhecimento em modelagem e manipulação de dados
  • Experiência na definição e acompanhamento de KPIs
  • Capacidade de traduzir dados técnicos em insights de negócio
  • Perfil analítico, proativo e orientado a resultados

Diferenciais (Desejáveis)

  • Experiência prévia no setor de óleo e gás, energia ou indústria
  • Experiência com dados operacionais de produção, manutenção ou engenharia
  • Conhecimento em sistemas corporativos como SAP, sistemas SCADA ou historiadores de dados
  • Experiência com ambientes em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou Google Cloud)
  • Experiência com ferramentas de ETL e integração de dados
  • Conhecimento em modelagem dimensional e Data Warehouse
  • Conhecimento em análise estatística e preditiva
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado
  • Experiência em ambientes ágeis

Atuação Presencial - Centro - Rio de Janeiro/RJ

Ambiente profissional inclusivo e humanizado.

title: Software Engineer - Solutions Engineering
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Help us shape the future of open source IT, devops, and IS, from bare metal to containers. Our goal is to revolutionise open source application and infrastructure operations.

We want to transform the world of software operations by enabling true model-driven operations via next-generation infrastructure-as-code. This will allow companies to run very efficient bare-metal operations for high-performance computing, private cloud, data lakes, AI/ML, and analytics. We need to invent some new technology, and we need to build some new products; we are therefore looking for someone who can lead and inspire a regional software engineering team to fulfill this initiative.

The Solutions Engineering team works in close collaboration with our managed infrastructure operations team, which runs many private OpenStack clouds and Kubernetes clusters for customers around the world. This enables us to improve our infra-as-code products based on our own real experience, mirroring that of our users and customers. We work in Python, creating open source automation capabilities that simplify operations for anybody, anywhere, who is building on Ubuntu.

Most of the team's work involves pure Python software development focused on enabling true DevOps workflows. We strive for high quality in both design, documentation, tests, and performance as we enhance operations code packages and Ubuntu itself in order to ensure our platform is the easiest, most robust, and best performing for driving your infrastructure.

This role is ideal for software engineers who want to work in a global team, have a passion for distributed systems and cloud computing, and an interest in the entire Linux stack - from kernel to networking to virtualization and containers.

What you will do

  • Work in Python and Golang to design and deliver open source software operations code
  • Work with the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, storage, to applications
  • Shape high quality open source monitoring and alerting infrastructure
  • Rethink open source operations for our customers and open source community
  • Demonstrate sound engineering design and testing principles in your code
  • Follow agile software development practices
  • Coach and develop your colleagues where you have insights
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Global travel up to 10% of time for internal and external events

Who you are

  • You are a passionate Python developer
  • You are organised and want your team to deliver timely, high quality software
  • You understand the importance of reliable operations in an agile world
  • You have sound knowledge of cloud computing concepts & technologies
  • You have practical knowledge of Linux and networking
  • You are a lifelong learner

Bonus points for

  • You have graduated with a university degree in Computer Science or related software engineering field
  • Golang programming skills

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Especialista de Inteligência de Mercado (Energia)
description:
Hydro Energia é uma empresa integrada de alumínio e energia com presença global, incluindo o Brasil. A Hydro Energia atua como uma comercializadora independente de energia elétrica, oferecendo serviços como gestão e otimização de portfólio de energia, consultoria regulatória e comercial, além de operações estruturadas no mercado de energia. No Brasil, a empresa tem escritórios em Belém e no Rio de Janeiro e é uma das maiores operadoras no mercado livre de energia no Norte do país. Aqui fazemos mais do que conectar energia: conectamos ideias, inovação e sustentabilidade. Nosso compromisso é construir um futuro energético mais eficiente, sustentável e inteligente.

O que oferecemos a você

Salário competitivo com o Mercado de Energia, com um pacote abrangente de benefícios, garantindo que você seja recompensado pelas suas contribuições.

A oportunidade de se juntar a equipes diversas em uma empresa líder global em alumínio e energias renováveis que está mudando o jogo do alumínio.

Um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, criativo, com projetos globais e ambições sustentáveis.

A Oportunidade de moldar a função e crescer na carreira por meio do desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal.

Você será parte de um negócio para o futuro juntando-se a nós em uma jornada transformadora.

O que você fará

  • Liderar tecnicamente e executar o processo de previsão de preços de energia de curto e médio prazo, promovendo sua evolução contínua e garantindo consistência metodológica, robustez analítica e qualidade dos resultados;
  • Atuar como assessor técnico da mesa de trading, fornecendo análises, cenários e recomendações para posicionamento e mitigação de riscos;
  • Acompanhar e participar ativamente de fóruns, reuniões e grupos de trabalho do Operador Nacional do Sistema Elétrico (ONS) e da Câmara de Comercialização de Energia Elétrica (CCEE) relacionados à formação do Preço de Liquidação das Diferenças (PLD), bem como monitorar regulação, notas técnicas e consultas públicas sobre o tema, antecipando potenciais impactos nos preços e nas estratégias comerciais da empresa;
  • Desenvolver, estruturar e evoluir processos automatizados, códigos e modelos internos associados à previsão de preços de curto e médio prazo (modelos principais e/ou satélites), assegurando atualização metodológica contínua, rastreabilidade e eficiência computacional;
  • Planejar e conduzir estudos complexos sobre formação de preços, avaliação de riscos e drivers estruturais do setor elétrico (expansão da geração, limites de transmissão, projeção de demanda, entre outros).

O que fará você ter sucesso?

Formação Acadêmica

  • Superior completo em Engenharia, Economia, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas;
  • Desejável Mestrado em Otimização, Planejamento Energético, Modelagem Quantitativa ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimentos e Habilidades

  • Experiência no mercado de energia elétrica;
  • Conhecimento dos modelos computacionais Newave, Decomp e Dessem;
  • Inglês avançado para conversação, escrita e leitura;
  • Pacote Office avançado;
  • Nível avançado em programação (necessário conhecimento de Python);
  • Nível avançado em ferramentas de Business Intelligence (preferencialmente Power BI);
  • Desejável conhecimento de técnicas avançadas de estatística e machine learning.

Perfil

  • Liderança técnica em modelagem e previsão de preços de energia;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e visão quantitativa;
  • Pensamento crítico para avaliação de modelos e premissas regulatórias;
  • Orientação a risco e suporte estratégico à mesa de trading;
  • Domínio de programação e automação de modelos (Python & BI);
  • Conhecimento aprofundado do setor elétrico e formação de PLD.

A Hydro valoriza diversas habilidades e perspectivas entre os empregados. Encorajamos todas as pessoas qualificadas a se inscreverem. Os perfis aderentes serão considerados independentemente de raça, religião, nacionalidade, etnia, idade, gênero, identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual ou deficiência. Nós nos esforçamos para oferecer oportunidades iguais para que todos possam contribuir e ter sucesso conosco.

Atuação na Norsk Hydro (Rio de Janeiro/RJ ou Belém/PA), podendo ser uma localidade flexível.

Inscrições exclusivamente pelo site da Hydro. No ato da inscrição os Certificados de escolaridade deverão ser anexados. Para maiores informações, visite

Todas as oportunidades estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PCD) e reabilitadas pelo INSS.

description:
Viridien ( is an advanced technology, digital and Earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. Overview

We are looking for passionate geoscientists to join our Interpretation Team at Viridien. In this role, you will contribute directly to Velocity Model Building (VMB) by performing seismic interpretation and providing essential geological support to Processing and VMB teams. From picking horizons to building velocity scenarios, you will work at the intersection of geology, geophysics, and advanced imaging tools, helping to transform complex seismic data into meaningful insights. Your work will play a critical role in delivering high-quality results to our clients and shaping decisions across energy and earth-data projects.

Responsibilities

  • Perform seismic interpretation for VMB, including horizon picking (unconformities, salt horizons, pre-salt).
  • Create local velocity scenarios.
  • Apply imaging tools, workflows, and data QC (attributes, velocities, maps).
  • Integrate geological and geophysical data for deeper insights.
  • Engage directly with clients to present results and understand their perspectives.

About The Team

You will join a diverse group of interpreters, geologists, and geophysicists who collaborate closely with Processing and VMB teams. Together, we tackle complex challenges, share knowledge, and drive innovation in seismic imaging. At Viridien, collaboration is key — you will be encouraged to bring your ideas forward and grow in a supportive environment.

Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Geophysics, Geology, or related field; or equivalent professional experience in the Oil & Gas industry.
  • Solid background in seismic interpretation, exploration geology, stratigraphy, or basin analysis.
  • Strong geophysical knowledge (seismic attributes, AVO, reservoir characterization, quantitative interpretation, well data QC/processing).
  • Ability to integrate data across scales (well, seismic, potential data).
  • Good understanding of seismic imaging and prospect assessment.
  • Experience with Pre-Salt or Brazilian Equatorial Margin is a plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
  • Effective communication and presentation skills in English.
  • Python programming is a plus.

  • Christmas Gift Card
  • Educational Assistance and Language Learning Programs
  • Continuous training via the Learning Hub, with both technical and behavioral courses.

Our Hiring Process

At Viridien, we are committed to delivering a respectful, inclusive, and transparent recruitment experience. Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide individual feedback to every applicant. Only candidates whose qualifications closely match the role criteria will be contacted for an interview. We do, however, aim to share personalized feedback with those who progress to the first round of interviews and beyond. We are also dedicated to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible to all. If you require any reasonable adjustments to fully participate in the application or interview stages, please don’t hesitate to contact your recruiter directly. We see things differently.   • Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, using Finagle and leveraging upon functional programming techniques and hexagonal architecture

  • Monitoring and observability with Prometheus
  • Running as much as possible in Kubernetes

We are a process-light organization that values human interactions. We value working in small, independent teams that feel like small startups within the company, and eschew coupling and centralizing where realistic. We understand that execution is the key to success and optimize processes to remove bottlenecks.

You will be responsible for

  • Work focused on backend applications, and be open to contribute to mobile and frontend development, according to business needs

We are looking for a person who has

  • At least 10 years of experience developing digital products in complex environments
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices architecture, and cloud technologies
  • Proven track record of designing and delivering large-scale systems that serve thousands (or even millions) of users

description:
Descrição da vaga

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Gerenciar os recursos administrativos, assistenciais e físicos da Unidade, garantindo o bom funcionamento dos serviços oferecidos no local.

Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino Superior Completo na Área de Saúde e atender aos critérios da Resolução SMS Nº 4852 de 31 de março de 2021, a saber:

Art. 1º Fica estabelecido que somente poderá ocupar cargo de Diretor ou Gerente de Unidades de Atenção Primária profissionais que preencham, ao menos, 4 (quatro) dos critérios listados neste artigo.

  • 1º Ter no mínimo 4 (quatro) anos de experiência de atuação direta nas Equipes de Saúde da Família.

title: Venue Technology Manager
description:
Venue Technology Manager

Department: Technology

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Venue Technology Manager is responsible for supporting the Technology team with venue specific technology related deliverables for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 TM (FWWC 2027) within Brazil. The role entails coordinating with all relevant parties the planning, implementation, readiness and operations of all Event Technology services pertinent to the tournament and / or associated events within Brazil.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Responsible to ensure all aspects of Technology, Telecommunications and Broadcast Technology Services are implemented in accordance with the pre-agreed FIFA Technology requirements at the assigned venue(s)
  • Manage a strong diverse Venue Technology team composed of paid staff, contractors and volunteers for operating the technology services at the assigned venue(s)
  • Collaborate with stakeholders’ groups, clients, providers, and government entities in relation to ensuring the delivery of technology services across all venues, in accordance with the defined governance structure
  • Manage and contribute to the venue technology working groups in accordance with the agreed governance structure across all aspects of the tournament programme (planning, implementation, readiness and operations)
  • Manage the technology demand / needs requirements for technology services across the tournament space (Technology Equipment Allocation Process)
  • Plan the delivery of suitable end user technology equipment and services to all FWWC 2027 departments and FIFA constituent groups, including hardware, services and consumables
  • Facilitate the collection and distribution of technology requirements of all client groups involved in the FWWC 2027 across all client groups, including, Media, Broadcast, Commercial, Football Technology etc.
  • Ensure that all information pertaining to infrastructure, services and spaces needed for the delivery and support of all technology services are communicated to, and understood by, venue/site authorities and respective delivery teams
  • Provide guidance and direction to relevant teams on matters relating to the structural build-out and technology services implementation, including the commissioning and final decommissioning of tournament venues
  • In collaboration with assigned personnel and Stadium partners, relevant parties (private and governmental) enable / support the timely delivery of venue technology services.
  • Identify and report on the progress of all critical dependencies in accordance with the reporting methodologies
  • Manage the asset tracking and management of deployed technology equipment
  • Track the progress of structural build-out and IT implementation leading up to the timely availability of components and services and including the commissioning and final decommissioning of the venues
  • Develop regular progress, risk and issue management reports in accordance with the governance structure / reporting methodologies and, or PMO systems
  • Follow-up with various stakeholders, providers, and government entities in relation to ensuring delivery of technology services / dependencies as per agreed requirements, service levels etc.
  • Support and ensure the team adhere to the IT Service management protocols
  • Ensure positive attitude from the Venue Technology teams and good relationship with all the parties, including FIFA teams, Local FIFA Subsidiary (LFS) areas/projects, end-users, suppliers, Host Country/ City counterparts
  • Manage the on-site IT Technicians and support teams during tournament time operations, including end-of-day reporting and incident escalation to Technology Command Centre.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field

Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years overall IT experience and minimum 4 years of experience in a similar role
  • Experience in the Sports / major event industry is a must
  • Proven track record of successful delivery of complex IT programs and projects

Skills & Competencies

  • Manager with proven track record in similar projects
  • Good knowledge of venue technology services across major sporting events
  • Have up to date knowledge and project management expertise in all event related technologies, including, all types of technology business solutions, community access TV (CATV), radio communications, wired communication, printing, broadcast contribution network, spectrum, audio and visual.
  • Ability to always maintain a professional demeanour. Consistently interacts professionally and works productively with all levels of employee.
  • Excellent cross group collaboration skills and demonstrated ability to lead virtual teams across groups, conflict management and driving consensus to deliver on program milestones
  • Good Leadership skills and able to manage and motivate other team members
  • Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills
  • Ability to adapt speech to audience coming from a broad spectrum of disciplines and with various levels of technical knowledge
  • Leadership and accountability across all areas of relevance
  • Strong political acumen and adaptable to a wide range of working environments

Certifications & Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English
  • Native or Fluent in Portuguese
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.
